messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: couple of managers asking about off-cycle promos and country-specific payroll timing. Can we summarize rules so managers don't miss cutoffs?
Eli Chen (Eng Manager): Quick one: I approved an off-cycle promotion yesterday for someone in Brazil. What effective date should I put and who signs the contract amendment?
Rohit (Comp & Rewards): For Brazil, align with local payroll vendor cutoff (usually 7 business days). Use the first of next month as standard effective date to avoid taxes unless you are doing retro. Comp-ops must review if the change is >15% or crosses band.
Ana - Payroll: To hit the next run attach signed comp-change + any contract amendment in the HR ticket before vendor cutoff. If missed, we process next cycle and file retro. Retro payments typically land one payroll cycle after paperwork finalization.
Lena (Legal): If salary appears in contract, send amendment using the Legal template and get a signature. For Brazil, we also need role description attached for local compliance.
Eli Chen (Eng Manager): Got it. What about temporary promos (3 months)? Do those need contract changes?
Maya (People Ops): Temporary promos <3 months: note "temporary" in ticket, no contract amendment unless salary is contractual. Add expected end date.
Eli Chen (Eng Manager): Who should I cc to speed approval?
Maya (People Ops): Tag @Rohit, @Ana, and @Lena. Add "urgent" in subject if you need retro. Also refer to pinned payschedule for vendor cutoffs.
people-bot: Reminder - payroll cutoff calendar is pinned in #people-ops/payschedule.
Eli Chen (Eng Manager): Thanks team, I filed ticket HR-4007 with attachments. Appreciate the quick answers :)
